steps.command: which nginx; nginx -v 2>&1; cat /etc/os-release | head -5; ls -la /etc/nginx/ 2>/dev/null; ls -la /etc/nginx/conf.d/ /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/ 2>/dev/null
id; ls -ld /var/www 2>/dev/null; apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq nginx
grep -n "log_format\|include\|limit_req" /etc/nginx/nginx.conf; echo "---"; ls -la /etc/nginx/conf.d/ /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/; echo "---"; cat /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf 2>/dev/null | head -40

mkdir -p /var/www/html && printf 'Welcome to the benchmark webserver' > /var/www/html/index.html && printf 'Page not found - Please check your URL' > /var/www/html/404.html && rm -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default && nginx -t

nginx 2>&1 || nginx -s reload 2>&1; sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "index:%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "notfound:%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/nope; echo "--- access log ---"; cat /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log
ls -ld /var/www /var/www/html; ls -l /var/www/html; echo "--- error log ---"; tail -20 /var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log; echo "--- processes ---"; ps aux | grep -i nginx | grep -v grep

curl -s -D - http://localhost:8080/; echo; curl -s http://localhost:8080/; echo; ls -la /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/ /etc/nginx/conf.d/; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 8080 || cat /proc/net/tcp | grep -i '1F90'
env | grep -i proxy; echo "---"; curl -s --noproxy '*' -D - http://127.0.0.1:8080/; echo; curl -s --noproxy '*' http://127.0.0.1:8080/

curl -s --noproxy '*' -o /dev/null -w "index:%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8080/; curl -s --noproxy '*' -o /dev/null -w "notfound:%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8080/nope; curl -s --noproxy '*' http://127.0.0.1:8080/nope; echo; echo "--- access log ---"; cat /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log; echo "--- error log ---"; cat /var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log
